process_rules.rule: No marijuana product may be sold for adult or medical use unless tested by a Commission-licensed Independent Testing Laboratory and deemed compliant with 935 CMR 500.160 / 501.160 standards.
Testing results valid for one year; products with testing dates in excess of one year are deemed expired and may not be dispensed until retested. Results maintained no less than one year.

Licensee must have a written policy for responding to results above acceptable limits, including notifying the Commission within 72 hours of non-remediable contamination and disposing of the production batch.

On failure, the licensee may reanalyze without remediation: reanalyze at the initial ITL; if it passes, submit a sample from the same batch to a second ITL for a Second Confirmatory Test. Passing requires the second ITL pass.

A failing batch may be remediated a maximum of two times; after the second failed attempt the product may not be sold and must be disposed of. Pesticide/PGR failures may not be remediated at all (Protocol § 7.3, § 8.0).
A production batch may be retested once (resampling for follow-up testing); records of the original analysis must be retained.
Only solvents listed in Exhibit 7 may be used in cannabis oil production; testing required only for solvents actually used; Class 1 solvents prohibited.
Sale of seeds is not subject to testing provisions; clones are subject but exempt from metals testing.

ITL results must include case narrative (letterhead, signed), chain-of-custody, and a summary of analytical results with sample identifier, methods, analytes, result/reporting limit, qualifiers, units, and dates.
process_rules.notes: Relevant to COA normalization: qualifiers and reporting limits are expected fields.

process_rules.rule: The CCC/Metrc system of record stores below-detection results as 0.0 in the Result field with the LOD in notes; the April 2026 protocol recommendations propose standardizing this as 'ND, LOD = X' and 'BQL, LOQ = X' notes.
process_rules.notes: A parser must preserve the raw ND/<LOD/<LOQ state and the LOD/LOQ value from notes rather than treating the 0.0 as a measurement.
